commits.message:
feat(ascend): add standalone shared pointer analysis (#2692)

Provide one PtrAnalysis<Rules>::analyze(Value) session for shared pointer
expressions, with Common rules for original axes and sub-axes and separate
CFO symbolic rules. Keep production consumer migrations in follow-up PRs.

Use PtrInfo for integer offsets and ordinary/block pointers. Support
signless integers up to 64 bits and use 64-bit index arithmetic at this
stage. Preserve exact source-width integer SSA and accumulate each addptr
increment after signed extension into a complete i64 pointer offset.
Descriptor origins, strides and block coordinates use index. As in the
legacy analyses, decomposition assumes source address arithmetic does not
overflow.

Keep generic result construction separate from operation analysis. Uniform
results retain their scalar origins; splat analysis reuses source bindings
at every shape. Derive shapes from result types, use static sub-axis lengths,
and create helper arithmetic only when subsequent computation needs it.

Share shape, axis and coordinate combinations. Preserve signed range
origins, clamp/select invariance and exact signed division with negative or
proven dynamic origins. Pointer tensor bitcasts preserve byte addresses
through equal widths and exact element-unit conversion across supported
widths; widening with insufficient divisibility proof remains unavailable.

Keep concrete parsers in cpp files, stable-IR caches and explicit boundary
bindings. Group helpers separately from rule entry points and operation
parsers, with matching declaration and definition order. CFO planning
records symbolic expressions without creating IR.

Validation: rebuilt all six public implementation and eleven test files;
113 CPU unit tests pass with no failures or skips using clang 15 / LLVM 22.
Applicable pre-commit checks pass for all 28 files in the commit.
No device or performance run.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

Let kernels declare TLA buffer and vector element types with the ``tla``
namespace instead of mixing it with ``triton.language``:

takes canonical Triton names such as ``tla.dtype("fp32")``.

commits.comment: 两处 lowering 语义修复：1) BubbleUpOperation 中 tensor.extract_slice 对 tt.make_range 的冒泡原先错误地用 parentOp 的 result 类型与“offsets 作 splat”替换，丢失 make_range 的 start 与 slice 的 stride/extent；改为基于 slice 结果类型构造 base=offset+start 的 splat 加 make_range(size)*stride，size==1 退化为 splat，动态 extent 或 size 非正/超 i32 上限则放弃冒泡保留原 slice；2) UnstructureConversionPass 间接 load 快路径原先仅用 requiresVolatileIndirectLoad 推断 volatile，丢失用户显式 isVolatile，改为 op.getIsVolatile() || 推断值。潜在风险：range slice 冒泡产生新的 make_range + muli/addi，若 sml 后端对非 2 的幂 extent 支持不足可能新失败；volatile 透传会阻止某些 CSE/合并优化。

issue #2797 报告 workspace 申请时按 32 位乘法导致溢出。main-dev 的 launcher 已重构为 C++ 共享运行时，但 prepareGrid 仍把逻辑块总数压进 uint32_t，超过上限即抛 overflow_error，即使 AUTO_MAP 已把实际下发块数压到物理核数。

改为拆分两个语义：logicalBlocks 提升为 uint64_t，workspace = workspace_size * logicalBlocks 全程 64 位；physicalBlocks 保持 uint32_t，只对真正下发给 CANN 的 block_dim 做 32 位校验。同时把 GRID_WARNING 打印格式改为 %llu。

新增 launcher_workspace_probe.cpp 与 test_workspace_overflow_2797.py：issue 原始 shape (256,64,1) 下 workspace == 2^32 且不截断；AUTO_MAP 下 logical=2^32、physical=40、workspace 按 64 位计算；未开 AUTO_MAP 时仍明确报错。

CI pre-commit 的 clang-format(v19.1.6) 与 yapf(0.43.0) 要求调整 launcher_workspace_probe.cpp 的注释折行与三元表达式排版，以及 test_workspace_overflow_2797.py 的参数列表折行。改动仅为格式，无逻辑变化。

2. 独立 C++ probe 从 pytest_ut 移到 unittest/launcher_ut/，避免把 C++ 用例混在 python 用例目录；

commits.message:
[TritonToLinalg](fix) support noinline for community testcase (#2933)

* [TritonToLinalg](fix) support noinline calls that carry pointers

Ascend has no device-side calling convention, so a private noinline callee
must be inlined before lowering. Two gaps made the upstream
test_tensor_descriptor_return_value case fail:

- TritonToUnstructure dropped scalar pointers whose producer the offset
  analysis does not model (e.g. one extracted from a noinline tt.call
  result), leaving an empty PtrOffsetInfo that later segfaulted when a
  splat/addptr user read the base.
- Inlining ran only after memory conversion, so BlockPtrAnalysis rejected
  the tt.call as an unsupported scalar pointer producer.

Inline calls that pass or return pointers before the memory stage (keeping
the scalar-only calls where their ABI is already settled), register an
unknown scalar pointer as an opaque base with zero displacement, and borrow
the program-info arguments the callee signature gained from the enclosing
function. Also add the ported community noinline cases as
pytest_ut/test_community_noinline.py.

* test: consolidate all noinline cases into test_noinline.py

Move the noinline cases out of test_kernel_function_call.py and rename
test_community_noinline.py to test_noinline.py, so a single file guards
noinline support. Also apply yapf/clang-format to satisfy pre-commit.
